descriptors.5: Exemplary — matches the 2026 bar in PRODUCT_SPEC, nothing material missing
descriptors.4: Strong — works well, minor polish gaps
descriptors.3: Adequate — present and functional but generic/unoptimized

gate.name: Build Health
checks: deps install + typecheck/lint with no fatal errors
launches without crash on first screen
no leaked secrets in client source (no service-role / private keys)

dimensions.name: Darshan / Daily Ritual Loop
dimensions.inspect: HomeScreen + temple/aarti/shankh/music components; 60fps Reanimated+Gesture Handler swipe; layered parallax temple; aarti haptics+particles+audio sync; persistent player; daily prasad + streak

dimensions.name: Faith Personalization Depth
dimensions.inspect: onboarding <45s + preferencesStore; primaryTradition transforms Home/Calendar/Wisdom/Learn/palette/voice/notifications; any cross-faith bleed caps this dim at 2

dimensions.name: Sensory Fidelity
dimensions.inspect: expo-av lifecycle (preload/crossfade/clean unmount/background); expo-haptics on swipe/tap/bell; UI-thread motion; no leaks or over-haptics

dimensions.name: Asset Moat Utilization
dimensions.inspect: real Suno tracks / ElevenLabs narration / painterly art / GN panels / films vs placeholders; no Linking.openURL to YouTube/Spotify for core experience

dimensions.name: Habit & Retention Systems
dimensions.inspect: streak engine, Today's Practice, smart non-spam notifications driven by calendar/time, visible progress, local progress schema

dimensions.name: Offline-First & Technical Excellence
dimensions.inspect: airplane-mode core works; Supabase background sync not blocking read; no big-JSON parse on JS thread at launch; clean TypeScript; no obvious jank

dimensions.name: Learning Experience Quality
dimensions.inspect: >=2 modules at Chalisa depth (synced text+translit+meaning+chant audio+art+retention check); text dumps <=2

dimensions.name: Monetization Taste & Flow
dimensions.inspect: native IAP (RevenueCat/expo IAP); contextual inline paywalls not just Store tab; beautiful paywall w/ original art; layered SKUs; no dark patterns

dimensions.name: Scriptural Authenticity, Safety & Trust
dimensions.inspect: verses correct & attributed; transliteration sane; decency canon (no horror, dignified deities, uplifting); honest privacy; no dark patterns; no leaked secrets

dimensions.name: Delight & Shareability
dimensions.inspect: holy-shit micro-moments; one-tap sacred share cards (verse+art+audio) native to WhatsApp/IG in dark mode
